subject: Request: Preservation & IR evidence for BlueHarbor telemetry alert
messages:
From: Laura Benton <laura.benton@blueharbor.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: BlueHarbor Security Team <security@blueharbor.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Telemetry spike / preservation request

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

BlueHarbor saw an unusual spike in API token usage tied to our integration with your hosted inference endpoint between 2026-09-09T22:40:00Z and 2026-09-10T02:10:00Z. We are initiating an internal investigation and need Redwood to preserve relevant artifacts while we triage. Specifically we need:

- Full request/response logs for the timeframe above (all regions)
- Any service-level alerts or scaling events, autoscaler logs
- Access logs showing service account usage (API keys, service accounts)
- Any rollout/rollbacks or deploys that occurred 9/9-9/10

Please confirm receipt and preservation within 24 hours. We will follow up with the legal preservation letter and a scoped list of additional artifacts if needed.

Also please include your incident response contact and an estimated ETA for initial artifact delivery. We are operating under our SOC2 incident coordination process and would like a short timeline so we can align our IR teams.

Thanks,
Laura Benton
Head of Security Operations
BlueHarbor Financial
laura.benton@blueharbor.com
+1 (415) 555-0189
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Benton <laura.benton@blueharbor.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, BlueHarbor Security Team <security@blueharbor.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry spike / preservation request

Laura — received, thank you for the heads up. We are treating this as an IR preservation request. Immediate actions taken:

- Snapshot of request/response logs for 2026-09-09T22:00:00Z through 2026-09-10T03:00:00Z has been exported to a sealed S3 bucket (read-restricted).
- Audit logs for API keys and service accounts have been flagged for retention and access restricted to IR team members.
- No deploys or config rollbacks are showing in the window on our primary serving fleet; we are still validating the secondary regions.
- Preserved autoscaler logs and node events; we will include container runtime events if relevant.

Marissa (cc) is leading artifact collection and Neha will coordinate SOC 2 control mapping for any findings. Can you confirm whether BlueHarbor needs a formal chain-of-custody and whether we should encrypt the package with your public key? We will need the legal preservation letter (if you have one ready) to attach to the chain-of-custody.

Estimated ETA for initial artifact package: 36 hours (we will prioritize logs first, then telemetry traces and telemetry-derived alerts). If you require a faster turnaround we can prioritize further — please confirm SLA.

Contact for Redwood IR:
Karthik Iyer
Director, Security and Compliance
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0112

-Karthik
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Benton <laura.benton@blueharbor.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry spike / preservation request

Laura — following up with what we'll provide and timeline: 

Artifacts we will deliver (initial package):
1) request-responses_20260909-20260910.log.gz (all regions) — token IDs redacted per customer PII policy, full request IDs preserved in sealed store
2) audit-keys-serviceaccounts_20260910.csv — API key usage events
3) autoscaler-events_20260909-20260910.jsonl
4) deployment-manifest-changes_30days.tar.gz (filtered to 9/1-9/10)
5) preservation_manifest/redwood-ir-preserve-manifest.txt (checksums + retention assertions)
6) soc2-control-mapping-IR-appendix.xlsx — mapping of preserved artifacts to SOC 2 Common Criteria controls and SIG/CAIQ references

ETA: initial package uploaded to the shared evidence Drive folder and sealed S3 bucket by end of day 2026-09-11 (PST). We will deliver the chain-of-custody record as a separate signed artifact and are happy to encrypt with your provided key.

Notes and asks:
- Please send the legal preservation letter (if available) and any constrained scope (e.g., exclude tokens tied to non-prod) so we can tailor redaction.
- If BlueHarbor needs a notarized or timestamped attestation for SOC2 purposes we can provide a formal attestation document; that will require an approval ticket with Legal (I will loop Legal if needed).

Attachments: redwood-ir-preserve-manifest.txt; soc2-control-mapping-IR-appendix.xlsx (will be uploaded to Drive link below).

Marissa Cole
Senior Incident Response Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0123
From: Laura Benton <laura.benton@blueharbor.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry spike / preservation request

Thanks Marissa — that ETA works for us. Our legal team is attaching a brief preservation letter and a limited-scope consent PDF to this thread (attached). A couple follow-ups from our side: 

- Can Redwood include MD5 checksums for the artifacts and provide a signed chain-of-custody file?
- BlueHarbor would like the SOC2 control mapping in a format we can import into our compliance tracker (spreadsheet OK).
- Please redact customer PII according to the policy you mentioned but preserve unique request IDs that we can use to reference events internally.

We will expect the initial artifact link and a short handoff call — can we schedule a 30-minute sync for Wednesday (2026-09-16) 10:00-10:30 PT? If that works, please send the calendar invite and the Drive/S3 links.

Attached: bh-legal-preservation-letter.pdf (signed)

—Laura
